description: Configuration for the AI-First Proposal Judge. Each artefact has its own path. Point the *Path values at local folders (which may be synced OneDrive/SharePoint folders). To pull/push artefacts directly from SharePoint Online instead, set sharepoint.enabled = true and fill in the sharepoint.* library folders; the *Path values then act as the local cache/staging locations. See docs/AUTOMATION-AND-DISTRIBUTION.md.
